sents.zh: 元朝的时候，中国的吃的东西多了很多。
sents.en: In the Yuan dynasty the food in China grew much more varied.

sents.zh: 因为很多地方的人都来了。
sents.en: Because people came from many places.

sents.zh: 北边的人从小就吃羊肉。
sents.en: People from the north ate lamb from childhood.

sents.zh: 他们也喝一种白色的茶。
sents.en: They also drank a kind of white tea.

sents.zh: 那种茶里放了牛的东西，又白又热。
sents.en: That tea had something from cows in it, and was white and hot.

sents.zh: 天冷的时候喝一杯，人一下子就好了。
sents.en: A cup of it in cold weather made a person feel better at once.

sents.zh: 从西边来的商人也带来了新东西。
sents.en: Merchants from the west brought new things too.

sents.zh: 有的东西很香，可以放在肉里面。
sents.en: Some were fragrant and could be put into meat.

sents.zh: 放了以后，肉就不一样了。
sents.en: Once added, the meat was quite different.

sents.zh: 南边的人还是喜欢吃米和鱼。
sents.en: People in the south still preferred rice and fish.

sents.zh: 所以一个国家里有很多种饭。
sents.en: So one country had many kinds of food.

sents.zh: 在大城里，你可以吃到很远地方的东西。
sents.en: In the big cities you could eat food from very far away.

sents.zh: 马可·波罗把他吃过的东西也写了下来。
sents.en: Marco Polo wrote down what he had eaten too.

sents.zh: 他说，有的东西他自己国家一点也没有。
sents.en: He said his own country had nothing like some of it.

sents.zh: 所以吃的东西也可以说是一种来往。
sents.en: So food, too, is a kind of coming and going between peoples.
